package.name: racer_apps
package.description: Roadmap phase 5 applications on top of the racer (OPTIONAL, outside the thesis; docs/notes/spiderbot-2026-11-11.md). Today: the spiderbot (5.3), waypoint patrol on the AMCL map with a pose rule held over N frames that stops the car, turns it towards the person, raises an alert and resumes. The decisions (pose rules, state machine, patrol geometry, command shaping) are pure Python and L1-tested without ROS. spiderbot_node publishes /drive_raw only, through safety_node; it never publishes /drive. fake_detector_node feeds the simulator synthetic people. Nothing here starts unless its own launch file is run.
